author: 13WHAM
title: Rochester Women Online launches June 2026 issue featuring 13WHAM
text:
Rochester Women Online launched its June 2026 issue with a networking night at Salvatore’s in Bushnell’s Basin. 13WHAM’s Selena Ramos attended as local pros and business owners connected with community leaders.
Perinton, N.Y. — Rochester Women Online celebrated a night of networking, connections, and professionals in the community with the launch of its June 2026 issue at Salvatores in Bushnell’s Basin.
Meteorologist Selena Ramos attended the event, representing 13WHAM. Folks from around the area stopped by to promote their local businesses, speak with community leaders, and make meaningful connections. A man was taken into custody after leading deputies on a chase across the county on Wednesday, according to the Monroe County Sheriff's Office. Greece, N.Y.
— A teen faces charged after leading deputies on a pursuit across a golf course, according to the Monroe County Sheriff's Office. A teen was involved in an argument when he was shot and killed on the city's east side earlier this month, according to the Rochester Police Department. The owner of a popular bar at the Port of Rochester says the city unfairly targeted his business after fire code violations prompted a temporary shutdown over the weekend.
A man's hand was cut off in an incident Sunday on the city's north side, according to the Rochester Police Department.
